LanguageData.OmniKiller.label: Omni Killer
LanguageData.OmniKiller.description: A device originating from Outerrealm Technology, capable of inflicting various types of damage by manipulating the causal relationships of targets, ultimately eliminating them. It is designed by a Outerrealm Technology engineer who believes that offense is the best defense.
